verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents use the Stripe API and search Stripe's knowledge base, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Terminal is part of the Stripe API, but the evidence never shows that the MCP server exposes Terminal operations such as reader management or in-person payment intents. missing for 10: documented Terminal-specific MCP tools (readers, locations, in-person payments), setup/auth details for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base, including documentation and support articles.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
